   Motorists advised to avoid areas in Jurong West over risk of flash floods
 Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox
 Moderate to heavy thundery showers with gusty winds were expected over the southern, eastern and central areas of Singapore from 6.10pm to 7.10pm on Oct 25.
 PHOTO: ST FILE
 Marisa Yeo
 Published   Oct 25, 2026, 06:49 PM
 Updated   Oct 25, 2026, 07:39 PM
 Set as preferred source Listen SINGAPORE – The public has been advised to avoid two areas in the west of Singapore, owing to a risk of flash floods on the evening of Oct 25.
 In social media posts on X, national water agency PUB advised the public to avoid the following areas for an hour:
 Jalan Boon Lay (from International Road to Enterprise Road) (from 6.37pm)
 Junction of Boon Lay Way and Corporation Road (from 6.48pm)
 In an earlier post at 5.54pm, the National Environment Agency said moderate to heavy thundery showers with gusty winds were expected over the southern, eastern and central areas of Singapore from 6.10pm to 7.10pm.
 The agency later said at 6.47pm that heavy rain is expected to continue till 8pm in northern, western and central Singapore.
 In its fortnightly weather advisory issued on Oct 16, the Meteorological Service Singapore said rainfall is expected over parts of Singapore during most afternoons in the second half of October.
 Thundery showers are expected to be localised and short in duration, it had said.
 Total rainfall for the rest of October is forecast to be below average for most parts of Singapore.
 On Facebook, some netizens shared photos and videos of their encounters with inclement weather, including in the Lakeside, Commonwealth and Thomson areas.
 One user shared a side-by-side comparison of a picture of clear blue skies taken earlier in the day next to a video of a heavy downpour in the evening.
